subtitle: Sovereign Intelligence — Guided Builds & Detailed Talent Inspector
changes: Added a detailed source-backed talent inspector with official returned rank descriptions, IDs, planned progress and upstream relationship notes.
Introduced optional guided build creation that copies player-selected activity, role and style into the existing planner without auto-selecting talents.
Connected-path highlighting distinguishes upstream and downstream source links while preserving Blizzard node IDs and original layout positions.
Enhanced the full-screen Talent Atlas with an optional collapsible inspector and compact controls for navigating detailed ranks.
Added a build review that summarizes manually allocated points and flags advisory source-link relationships for further review.
Kept existing rank controls, undo/redo, build saving, Media Studio, local storage and account features unchanged. No fabricated rarity, unlock difficulty or combat simulation claims.
